title: Inverse image of etale sheaves of modules over a constant ring is exact
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $R$ a commutative ring, $R_U$ and $R_V$ the constant sheaves of rings with value $R$ on the small etale sites $U_{\Et}$, $V_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)=\Mod(R_T)$ the abelian category of sheaves of $R_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $u^{-1}:\Ab(V_{\Et})\to\Ab(U_{\Et})$ be the inverse image of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $u^{-1}$ also the inverse image of sheaves of sets and of rings [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. Then: (1) the inverse image of the sheaf of rings $R_V$ is canonically isomorphic to $R_U$: the morphism of sheaves of rings $c:u^{-1}R_V\to R_U$ adjoint to the map $\gamma:R_V\to u_*R_U$ induced, by the universal property of sheafification, by the constant sections $R\to R_U(U\times_VW)$, is an isomorphism; (2) for a sheaf $G$ of $R_V$-modules, $u^{-1}G$ carries a unique structure of sheaf of $u^{-1}R_V$-modules, hence of $R_U$-modules through (1), such that $u^{-1}$ of the action map is the action map; this defines a functor $u^{-1}:\Mod(V_{\Et},R)\to\Mod(U_{\Et},R)$ compatible with $u^{-1}$ on abelian sheaves under the forgetful functors, equal (up to a canonical isomorphism natural in $G$) to the module pullback $u^*G=u^{-1}G\otimes_{u^{-1}R_V}R_U$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; (3) this functor is additive and exact (it preserves finite limits and finite colimits), and it is left adjoint to the direct image $u_*:\Mod(U_{\Et},R)\to\Mod(V_{\Et},R)$, $(u_*F)(W)=F(U\times_VW)$ with $R_V$ acting through $\gamma$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], the unit and counit being those of the adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ on abelian sheaves.

source.place: Lemma 04JC (lemma-flat-pullback-exact): f^{-1} is exact on abelian sheaves and f^* is exact for a flat morphism of ringed topoi; here u is flat as a morphism of ringed sites because u^{-1}R_V -> R_U is an isomorphism (constant sheaves: sites.tex Example 0H7J, Mor(E, F) = Map(E, Gamma(F))); used in sites-cohomology.tex Section 0735 (section-base-change-map) for flat pullback on D^+

proof.text: Choose Lr, ar, er, ea, gamma and c with both hom-equivalence comparisons and the constant-section equation from the constant-ring comparison.
Apply module transport to obtain L0, LM, e0, e, t and am, the unique transported action, the natural tensor comparison, and the abelian hom, unit and counit equations.

The composite LM with the faithful additive module-to-abelian forgetful functor is naturally isomorphic through e to the composite of source forgetting and abelian inverse image. This latter composite is additive and preserves finite limits by existing instances. Transfer these properties across e. Mathlib Functor.additive_of_comp_faithful yields additivity of LM; preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves yields its finite-limit preservation because the target forgetful functor reflects finite limits. Finally am.isLeftAdjoint gives preservation of all colimits, hence finite colimits. Assemble these three proofs with the witness packages.

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks sites-modules 03D2/03D3/03D6/03D7/04JC and sites 0H7J. The abelian inverse image of def-weil-pbc-inverse-image cannot carry the bilinear action map or the ring structure, so a new node (lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures, Stacks 00X6/00YV) supplies u^{-1} on sheaves of sets and rings, exact, compatible with the abelian one. Step 1: u^{-1}R_V = R_U by Yoneda from the adjunction and the constant-sheaf adjunction (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-maps-global-sections = constantSheafAdj). Step 2: module structure (03D2), compatibility with forget. Step 3: u^* = u^{-1} since the change of rings is along an isomorphism. Step 4: additive and exact through the faithful exact forgetful functor (lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful) and prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact. Step 5: adjunction from the new node lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-module-adjunction (03D3), with the R_V-structure on u_*F identified as restriction along gamma. Statement clarified (not changed in substance): the map c and gamma are named, the set/ring inverse image, the tensor product and the direct image are cited, and it is said that unit and counit are the abelian ones (used by lem-weil-pbc-retract-supplied).
